title: FLUX 3 Klein
description: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Klein — the fast, low-cost FLUX 3: text-to-image and image editing in one model, with up to 10 reference images (free) and five sizes from 768px to 4K. Billing: per image by size — 768px = 11, 1K = 12, 1.5K = 15, 2K = 19, 4K = 48 credits. Use POST /v1/cost for an exact quote.
pricing_text: Pricing: 12 credits per generation (varies by resolution).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. "auto" (default) follows the first reference image when editing, or lets the model pick a ratio from the prompt for text-to-image.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate. Each image is billed at its size's price.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or of the edit to apply to the reference images. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 10) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Reference images cost nothing extra.

size.description: Output size by approximate pixel count: 768px ≈ 0.6 MP, 1K ≈ 1 MP, 1.5K ≈ 2 MP, 2K ≈ 4 MP, 4K ≈ 16 MP. Sets the price: 11 / 12 / 15 / 19 / 48 credits per image. 4K is returned as a JPEG, smaller sizes as PNG.
